description: PR #3145 repaired only the three reached TPC-Havoc rewrite paths (Presto-family 1_v7 ARRAY_AGG in dialect_compat.py, postgres dual in dialect_compat.py:124, BigQuery from-less in cloud_compat.py:59-62) and pins 20 regression nodes at the floor. Probing the declared minimum sqlglot==25.6.0 (pyproject.toml:28 allows >=25.6.0,<31.0.0) still fails: (1) benchbox/core/tpchavoc/spark_query_transformer.py:106 raises AttributeError: module 'sqlglot.expressions' has no attribute 'Expr', breaking every Databricks TPC-Havoc render; (2) tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_cloud_compat.py::test_snowflake_empty_group_rewrite_is_targeted fails because old sqlglot renders HAVING NOT SUM(...) IS NULL instead of HAVING SUM(; (3) tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_dialect_compat.py::test_postgres_alias_rewrite_preserves_order_by_aliases fails for the same HAVING-text drift. Repro: uv run --with sqlglot==25.6.0 -- python -m pytest -n 0 tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_presto_compat.py tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_cloud_compat.py tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_dialect_compat.py gives 3 failed, 35 passed. Bisect the first good version before choosing raise-floor vs repair-all; a partial claim is the worst outcome.
